habitat: Open and semi-open country, farmland, scrub, village edges and towns, especially where tall palms and scattered trees; perches on powerlines and tall bare trees; avoids dense forest interiors; plains to about 2000 m
description: Ashy woodswallow of open country, farmland, scrub and village edges with tall palms and scattered trees; aerial insect-eater often seen huddled on powerlines and bare trees, avoiding dense forest interiors.
